sections.title: 1. Data Collection
sections.content: When you use our services, we may collect data such as your name, contact details, and company information. This data is used to improve service quality.

sections.title: 2. Data Usage
sections.content: Collected data is processed to provide you with a better experience, verify transactions, and comply with legal obligations.

sections.title: 3. GDPR Compliance
sections.content: ATRON stores all your data on encrypted servers in compliance with GDPR standards and does not share it with third parties without your consent.
